newsitem.title: USA: Ecolab to buy food industry cleaning firm.
newsitem.headline: Ecolab to buy food industry cleaning firm.

text.p: Ecolab Inc said Monday it agreed to purchase the Chemidyne Marketing Division of Chemidyne Corp of Macedonia, Ohio.
Chemidyne Marketing provides cleaning and sanitizing products and equipment to the meat, poultry and processed foods markets in the United States.

Annual sales for Chemidyne Marketing are approximately $17 million. Closing is expected to occur as soon as clearance is received under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act and the other closing conditions are satisfied.
Terms of the agreemnet were not disclosed.
Ecolab develops and markets premium cleaning, sanitizing and maintenance products and services for the hospitality, institutional and light industrial markets.
